name: Steve Bray
background: A 2012 and 2022 Republican primary challenger to Rep. Steve Harshman in HD37. Oil City’s July 22, 2022 Natrona County questionnaire compilation listed him but did not link a completed questionnaire; a July 2022 Politics in the Park forum preview said he did not attend that event.
